isp_entry.description: The ISP's entry: each frame's header facts latched as its SOF enters, and every line cropped to the width the ISP was built for.

inputs.name: hdr_frame_seq
inputs.description: The header's frame count: which frame this is, as the source counts.

outputs.name: ctx_frame_seq
outputs.description: Which frame this is, as the source counts, held for the frame.

SAMPLE_BITS.description: The width of one sample: the depth the receiver aligns every source to.

WIDTH.description: The widest line the ISP was built for; a wider line is cropped to it.

isp_axis.description: The ISP's RGB stream dressed as AXI4-Stream video: the framebuffer's word for a frame writer, or the cable's three bytes for a raster.

DATA_BITS.description: The ISP's traced output word, from its published contract.

FB_WORD.description: 1: the framebuffer's word, xRGB with a pad byte above the cable's three, for a frame writer; 0: the cable's three bytes, for a raster.

tee_shim.description: One ISP stream, two switchable consumers, never stalling.

DATA_BITS.description: The ISP's traced output word, from its published contract.

scanout.description: The display raster, genlocked to the stream by its clock's fine phase shifter, taking its mode and placement from a register file on another clock.

inputs.name: clk
inputs.description: The raster's clock: the pixels in and the video out both ride it.

inputs.name: locked
inputs.description: The raster clock's lock.

inputs.name: pic_w
inputs.description: The width of the frame arriving, on the raster's clock: the stream's, taken in vertical blanking.

inputs.name: pic_h
inputs.description: Its height.

inputs.name: reg_clk_sel
inputs.description: The display clock's row, taken in the copy with the mode it is for.

inputs.name: arm_req
inputs.description: The register file holds its values for a copy.

inputs.name: param_follow
inputs.description: 1: follow the stream; 0: hold the mode unsteered, painting the fill.

inputs.name: sink
inputs.description: The output jack's hot-plug line, as the pin has it: a sink connecting meets the quiet again.

inputs.name: ps_done
inputs.description: The raster clock's fine phase step is made.

inputs.name: s_axis
inputs.description: The picture, as an elastic stream: tuser starts a frame.

outputs.name: clk_sel
outputs.description: The display clock's row, as the copy has it: switched at a frame's end, for the clock select.

outputs.name: ps_en
outputs.description: One fine phase step of the raster clock.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: sof-per-frame [2:0], locked, armed, underflow, misalign, refused, alive [10:8], vsyncs [13:11], the genlock's own lock at 14.

DW.description: One pixel, on the stream and the transmitter.

XB.description: Bits of a line's total: the longest line the raster can scan.

FILL.description: What it paints outside the picture (0x101010).

G_LEAD.description: How many lines early a frame's start should arrive: storage the elastic before the raster holds.

QUIET_BITS.description: The bit of a count of the display clock's cycles that ends the raster's quiet, at each clock row, 8 bits a row, row 0 lowest: from the clocks the design makes.

clock_select.description: The display's pixel clock, one of three chosen at run time through cascaded glitch-free global multiplexers; the chosen row's lock and step-done passed on, the lock held low a while after a switch.

inputs.name: sel
inputs.description: The build's clock table row: 0, 1 or 2.

HOLD.description: Display clocks the raster is held in reset after a switch.

tmds_clocking.description: A TMDS serializer's clocks from the PLL beside it: the x5 output through a BUFIO for the bit clock and a BUFR dividing by five for the serializer's pixel clock, cleared on lock gained, the PLL's feedback through a deskew BUFR -- rgb2dvi's arrangement, the PLL outside so the firmware can reprogram it.

inputs.name: pclk
inputs.description: The PLL's input: the display's pixel clock.

inputs.name: pclk_locked
inputs.description: That clock is steady.

inputs.name: x5
inputs.description: The PLL's x5 output, unbuffered.

inputs.name: fb_out
inputs.description: The PLL's feedback out.

inputs.name: locked
inputs.description: The PLL's lock.

outputs.name: fb_in
outputs.description: The feedback, back to the PLL through the deskew buffer.

outputs.name: rst
outputs.description: The transmitter's reset: high until both clocks lock.

video_cdc.description: A raster into a transmitter's own pixel clock -- the same frequency, an unknown phase -- through a sixteen-entry ring the reader follows a few entries behind the writer.

inputs.name: wclk
inputs.description: The raster's clock.

inputs.name: vid_in
inputs.description: The raster.

inputs.name: rclk
inputs.description: The transmitter's pixel clock: the raster clock's frequency, any phase.

inputs.name: rrst
inputs.description: The transmitter's reset, asynchronous: the reader is placed behind the writer as it ends.

outputs.name: vid_out
outputs.description: The raster, in the transmitter's clock.

LAG.description: Entries the reader starts behind the writer.
